q: If a > 0 in y = ax² + bx + c, the parabola has a lowest point.
why: a > 0 makes it open upwards (a U shape), so the vertex is a minimum.

q: Profit P = −q² + 20q. Which q gives the most profit?
why: The vertex is at q = −b/(2a) = −20/(−2) = 10, halfway between the roots 0 and 20.
